_meta.notes: SYNTHETIC. The same Duna link, photographed AFTER the ascent command has been pressed, so the row carries its own lifecycle chip rather than sitting idle. Driven through a real click (`_scene.before`) rather than fed from the fixture, because the command lifecycle is state the widget owns and nothing on the wire carries it: a fixture could only fake the chip, and a faked chip is a picture of a shape.

_scene.caption: Ascent autopilot commanded across a 12.5-minute link: the row that was pressed carries a status chip, the two that were not stay idle
